nodes.title: Threshold
nodes.direction: One centred column: the field is the page, tone and Suggest on one line beneath, three equal recent cards on a shelf below, Browse all closing the row.

nodes.title: Two doors
nodes.direction: Split screen of equal weight: a start form on the left (field, suggestions, tone list with hints, button), a continue list of wide cards plus Browse all on the right; first run collapses to the left door centred.

nodes.title: Sentence and spotlight
nodes.direction: The start is a sentence (Teach me ___ for a [tone] mind) with Suggest 3 as a combobox dropdown; the most recent subject is a spotlight card, the other two and Browse all stacked beside it.

nodes.title: Lantern hall
nodes.direction: Sparse and centred with extreme scale contrast: a 36 px light field alone at the centre, tone pills, model and Suggest as quiet small controls, recents dimmed far below.

nodes.title: Even keel
nodes.direction: Balanced medium density on an 8 px rhythm: field and settings row as two surfaces, recents as full cards with large thumbnails and full-weight numbers; start and continue weigh the same.

nodes.title: Ledger
nodes.direction: Dense and top-left anchored: compact field, one thin settings row, recents as table rows with small thumbnails and aligned numeric columns; everything visible on a short window.

nodes.title: Native
nodes.direction: System Segoe UI Variable in its three optical sizes, the PoC's own face: Display semilight for the question, Text for the body, Small for labels; sentence case, no mono.

nodes.title: Reading lamp
nodes.direction: Newsreader, an optical-size reading serif, for the question, card titles and the welcome line (italic placeholder); Segoe UI Variable Text for every control; small tracked capitals for labels.

nodes.title: Field notes
nodes.direction: IBM Plex Sans light for the question and body, IBM Plex Mono for labels, counts, dates and the example line: a technical notebook voice, uppercase mono labels.

nodes.title: Lit question
nodes.direction: Learn palette with the light on the start: glow behind the field, amber underline and caret, glowing primary; tone, model and recents stay muted until hovered.

nodes.title: Lanterns on the shelf
nodes.direction: Learn palette with the light on the subjects: a quiet ink-and-grey start, thumbnails glowing at full strength, amber understood counts and Continue links.

nodes.title: Hearth
nodes.direction: Learn palette with every actionable element warm: amber selected tone, model value, Suggest, Continue and Browse all; cards take the warm surface on hover.

nodes.title: Still flame
nodes.direction: Almost nothing moves: a 240 ms fade on arrival, 150-250 ms ease-out hover changes, chips fading in, a breathing Suggest label while thinking; no travel.

nodes.title: Kindling
nodes.direction: The glow answers you: it kindles on arrival with a staggered rise, grows with the length of the typed subject, and swells as the button flares on submit.

nodes.title: Embers
nodes.direction: The learning node's language: a light crosses the underline on arrival, runs into the button on submit and bursts, embers rise while Suggest thinks, a light runs through a hovered thumbnail.
